parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['api_name','changes'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const changes=Array.isArray(body.changes)?body.changes:[];if(changes.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'changes must be non-empty'}}];const changeTypes=['breaking','deprecated','new_endpoint','new_field','behavior_change','performance','security','bug_fix','rate_limit','auth'];const formattedChanges=changes.slice(0,25).map((c,i)=>({id:c.id||('CHG-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),type:changeTypes.includes(c.type)?c.type:'behavior_change',severity:c.severity||( c.type==='breaking'||c.type==='security'?'critical':c.type==='deprecated'?'high':'medium'),endpoint:c.endpoint||'',field:c.field||'',description:(c.description||'').trim().slice(0,400),migrationSteps:(c.migration_steps||'').slice(0,400),deprecationDate:c.deprecation_date||'',replacedBy:c.replaced_by||'',affectedVersions:c.affected_versions||''}));const hasBreaking=formattedChanges.some(c=>c.type==='breaking');const hasSecurity=formattedChanges.some(c=>c.type==='security');return[{json:{valid:true,apiName:body.api_name.trim(),version:body.version||'',releaseDate:body.release_date||new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],changes:formattedChanges,changeCount:formattedChanges.length,hasBreaking,hasSecurity,migrationGuideUrl:(body.migration_guide_url||'').trim(),docsUrl:(body.docs_url||'').trim(),statusPageUrl:(body.status_page_url||'').trim(),supportEmail:(body.support_email||'').trim(),developerEmailList:body.developer_email_list||'',slackWebhook:body.slack_webhook||'',replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You write API changelog notifications for developer audiences. Good API changelogs: are honest and specific about what changed and why, give precise migration steps for breaking changes, flag deprecations with enough lead time to act, separate breaking from non-breaking clearly, and include code examples where helpful. Developers need to know exactly what to do, not just that something changed. Always respond in valid JSON only.
